Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Familial Bond
Requires a Laibon.
Only usable on an action directed at another Laibon you control or on a bleed against you.
+1 intercept.
If this block fails, the acting minion may choose to make the action fail.
If the action succeeds, this Laibon may lock (after resolution)
to enter combat with the acting minion.

Can be used vs 0 stealt? I beleive cannot,but want to be sure

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Rulebook 6.2.2:

Likewise, intercept can be added during an action only when needed (that is, only by a blocking minion when the acting minion's stealth exceeds his intercept).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Maybe to explain it with a bit more words:

A vampire must attempt to block to play intercept. So, C attempts to block and can play Familial Bond. The text of Familial Bond gives intercept, and apart from that references "If this block fails". So it will happen, if you do not have enough intercept (or are forced not to block e.g. with Elder Impersonation) - it doesn't matter that you never had enough intercept to catch the acting vampire, that is something the game doesn't keep track of. And nothing the card asks for. What's important is that you played the card, and didn't block successfully.

Prince of Bonn, Germany
